description: Aalto University publishes a tram-passenger workflow that estimates passengers at stops in Jätkäsaari, Helsinki. It combines multiple data sources and feeds the fused data into a machine-learning pipeline. The native description names KNN, linear regression, random forest and XGBoost, compared with manual-count and Bluetooth ground truth in two scenarios. It identifies the work as part of Chris Yung’s master’s thesis. Zenodo provides the software ZIP freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the named Helsinki area; collection dates, stop counts, sample rates and exact source schemas are not specified. Related ACUMEN train-passenger estimation uses a different method and transport mode. A limitation is that validation metrics and data access are not established by the metadata. No passenger observations or code were downloaded, and comparative model performance was not independently tested.
